_README: CANONICAL REGISTRY. Every reportable number lives here exactly once. Do not restate a value in prose without citing its key. 'verified' = still matches its artifact; 'reproducible' = re-running the pipeline regenerates that artifact. They are independent — several numbers here are verified but NOT reproducible because the OSM network behind them was overwritten (docs/DATA_LOSS_2026-07-24.md). Run scripts/verify_numbers.py to re-check every entry. REPORTABLE PRECISION: pooled ROC-AUC is reportable to THREE significant figures (0.905). The fourth digit is not stable across platforms — see platform_drift_pooled_auc — and must not be compared, ranked or differenced. Stored values keep full precision so the artifact check stays exact; the RULE governs what may be written in prose, a poster or a slide. ANGULAR PRECISION: circular quantities are NOT AUCs and take a different rule. With n=36 usable steps and a per-step spread of ~56 deg, the standard error of a mean angular difference is ~9 deg, so mean angles are reportable to ONE decimal place and differences smaller than ~19 deg (2 SE) are NOT established. Circular correlations have an approximate SE of 1/sqrt(n) = 0.17 here, so they are reportable to TWO decimals and |r| below ~0.33 is not distinguishable from zero. These are rules of thumb from the observed spread, not exact tests; the fold-level spread (sd ~47-50 deg on 6 folds) is wider still and governs any per-fire claim.
config_hash_note: The per-entry config_hash is re-stamped on every build, so it marks the config a build SAW, not the config a number was PRODUCED under. It moved 0b6eb481177a… -> 51ec446843b6… between the 2026-08-01 build and the 2026-08-02 (PHASE 5 STEP 4) build. Removing the TOP-RANKED feature by permutation importance (+0.07726) IMPROVES mean-of-folds by +0.0270 and the far band by +0.0533, while lowering pooled by -0.0142. For three of six fires the feature equals the ERA5 window length exactly (2.88 / 6.88 / 6.88 d) because those windows contain zero wet samples, so it acts as a per-fire constant — a fire fingerprint that raises pooled and damages transfer. column_addition_floor_pooled_p95.caveat: THE COLUMN-ADDITION FLOOR, and it is separate from the Session 10 platform floor (0.0064). An arm that changes the feature count must clear THIS to claim a pooled gain. Null mean is +0.0041, sd 0.0040: adding two columns raises pooled AUC on average even when the columns are meaningless.
column_addition_floor_pooled_p95.notes: Session 13. 60 draws, 6-fire LOGO-CV each, estimator seed fixed at 20250603 so only the noise content varies. No model default, target, threshold or Arm A artifact was changed.

column_addition_floor_far_band_p95.notes: Session 13. 60 draws, 6-fire LOGO-CV each, estimator seed fixed at 20250603 so only the noise content varies. No model default, target, threshold or Arm A artifact was changed.

arme_pooled_percentile_of_null.derivation: Percentile at which Arm E's observed pooled delta (+0.0059) falls in the 60-draw column-addition null. Regenerate: python scripts/noise_envelope.py --run --seeds 60 && --aggregate
arme_pooled_percentile_of_null.caveat: THE QUANTIFIED ARM E VERDICT. Inside the null, not beyond it — the pooled gain is what adding two columns does anyway. Supersedes Session 12's single-draw comparison.
arme_pooled_percentile_of_null.notes: Session 13. 60 draws, 6-fire LOGO-CV each, estimator seed fixed at 20250603 so only the noise content varies. No model default, target, threshold or Arm A artifact was changed.

arme_steep_percentile_of_null.caveat: The pre-registered expectation was that a directional slope feature helps on STEEP ground. At the 40th percentile of the null it does not — this is the cleanest disconfirmation in the session.
arme_steep_percentile_of_null.notes: Session 13. 60 draws, 6-fire LOGO-CV each, estimator seed fixed at 20250603 so only the noise content varies. No model default, target, threshold or Arm A artifact was changed.

Pooled AUC is the primary metric and there Arm E sits at the 66.7th percentile.

noise_importance_magnitude_sd.derivation: Standard deviation of the row-weighted permutation importance of a pure-noise column across 120 observed noise columns (60 draws x 2). Regenerate: python scripts/noise_envelope.py --run --seeds 60 && --aggregate
noise_importance_magnitude_sd.caveat: THE YARDSTICK FOR SMALL IMPORTANCES. Noise-column importance is centred at -0.00004 with this sd and ranks 13-18 of 18 (median 16). Any importance in this project below about 0.0006 is inside the noise band.
noise_importance_magnitude_sd.notes: Session 13. 60 draws, 6-fire LOGO-CV each, estimator seed fixed at 20250603 so only the noise content varies. No model default, target, threshold or Arm A artifact was changed.

arme_upslope_alignment_percentile_of_noi.derivation: Percentile at which upslope_alignment's importance (+0.00072) falls among 120 pure-noise column importances. Regenerate: python scripts/noise_envelope.py --run --seeds 60 && --aggregate
arme_upslope_alignment_percentile_of_noi.caveat: CORRECTS SESSION 12. That session compared upslope_alignment to a SINGLE noise column (+0.00061) and concluded the feature was worth what a random number is worth. Against the distribution that single column was itself at the 99.2nd percentile. upslope_alignment sits +2.79 sd above the noise mean, so the feature is NOT noise — it carries a small, detectable signal. Its fold sd (0.0027) is still ~3.8x its own mean, so it is unstable across folds, and it is far too small to move model-level AUC out of the null.
arme_upslope_alignment_percentile_of_noi.notes: Session 13. 60 draws, 6-fire LOGO-CV each, estimator seed fixed at 20250603 so only the noise content varies. No model default, target, threshold or Arm A artifact was changed.

redundancy_upslope_rise_in_fold_sd.derivation: Rise in upslope_alignment's row-weighted permutation importance when the correlated elev_above_source_m (r=0.243) is removed, in units of the feature's own fold spread. Regenerate: python scripts/redundancy_decomposition.py --run --draws 30 && --aggregate
redundancy_upslope_rise_in_fold_sd.caveat: THE REDUNDANCY VERDICT: NOT redundancy. Removing the correlated feature moves the importance by +0.00005, which is 0.018x its own fold sd — no meaningful recovery of stolen credit. Rank goes 15/18 to 13/17, the same relative position. The Arm E null is clean and therefore stronger than before.
redundancy_upslope_rise_in_fold_sd.notes: Session 13 Phase 2. Four configurations so a feature substitution is not confounded with a column-count change, each read against its own matched noise null. No model default, target, threshold or Arm A artifact was changed.

redundancy_e17_pooled_percentile_of_null.derivation: Percentile at which the 17-column Arm E (elev_above_source_m removed) falls in its own matched 17-column noise null, against the 15-column Arm A baseline. Regenerate: python scripts/redundancy_decomposition.py --run --draws 30 && --aggregate
redundancy_e17_pooled_percentile_of_null.caveat: Replicates the 18-column result: 56.7th percentile against 66.7th. Pooled AUC stays inside the null under both feature sets, so the null does not depend on the presence of the correlated feature.
redundancy_e17_pooled_percentile_of_null.notes: Session 13 Phase 2. Four configurations so a feature substitution is not confounded with a column-count change, each read against its own matched noise null. No model default, target, threshold or Arm A artifact was changed.

arme_mof_gain_without_smallest_fold.derivation: Arm E's mean-of-folds gain recomputed over the five fires excluding gangneung_2023, in the 17-column configuration. Regenerate: python scripts/redundancy_decomposition.py --run --draws 30 && --aggregate
arme_mof_gain_without_smallest_fold.caveat: THIS CLOSES THE ONE EXCEEDANCE. Mean-of-folds was the single metric where Arm E beat all noise draws (100th percentile in both configurations). Excluding gangneung_2023 — 396 rows, 8 positive cells, 0.26% of the evidence, one sixth of the mean-of-folds vote — the gain is -0.0002 in the 17-column configuration and +0.0044 in the 18-column one. The exceedance was a fold, not a finding. See docs/fold_sizes.md.

redundancy_dropping_elev_above_source_po.derivation: Change in pooled OOF AUC when elev_above_source_m is removed from Arm A's 16 features, on a same-platform replication. Regenerate: python scripts/redundancy_decomposition.py --run --draws 30 && --aggregate

That is inside the column-count null, so it is not established, but it points the same way as the feature's low rank (8/18, +0.00217). A MEASUREMENT ON A REPLICATION, NOT a proposal to change Arm A, which stays frozen.

l0_hazard_source_ranking_spearman.derivation: Household vulnerability ranking correlation between the elliptical physical hazard and the trained spread_v2 hazard at 영덕, matched ERA5 weather, identical refuges/horizon/thresholds. Regenerate: python scripts/vulnerability_sensitivity.py --hazard
l0_hazard_source_ranking_spearman.sample: 영덕 124 OSM 건물 / Paradise 989 OSM 건물
l0_hazard_source_ranking_spearman.caveat: THE DEFERRED PHASE 1c, NOW DEFINED. Two structurally different hazard models — an analytic travel-time ellipse and a gradient-boosted probability model — give nearly the same household ranking, and the tail MATCHES: 24 households fail under both, exactly 1 under the trained model only, 0 under the elliptical only. The layer's output is dominated by geometry (where households, refuges and roads are) rather than by fire physics. ⚠ NOT a claim that either hazard source is correct. ⚠ The trained model is fitted on all six fires including 영덕, so its 영덕 hazard is in-sample.

l0_egress_vs_vulnerability_yeongdeok.derivation: Within-site correlation at 영덕 between a household's edge-disjoint egress-path count to any refuge and its vulnerability score. Regenerate: python scripts/vulnerability_sensitivity.py --network

l0_egress_vs_vulnerability_yeongdeok.caveat: THE NETWORK-STRUCTURE HYPOTHESIS IS NOT SUPPORTED. The hypothesis predicts a NEGATIVE correlation (fewer independent egress paths, higher vulnerability).
